body:
Adds `research/deadtime-twin`: an ideal linear photon-counter twin vs a SPAD lidar with dead time. Results come from `experiments/results.txt` (exact quadrature checked against Monte Carlo): count saturation, the paralyzable two-flux ambiguity, first-photon range bias of −N/(2√π)σ at small N saturating near −2σ, and a Coates correction that removes it. 10 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok (225 projects). README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added. Stylised, no sensor data.
